ITA-9.2.106 uttamaśuddhiḥ उत्तमशुद्धिः
Optimal cleansing
Achievement of an adequate degree of dosha evacuation during cleansing therapy.

ITA-5.58.5 uttamā उत्तमा
Red boil resembling green gram or black gram in size on the penis
A disease of the penis characterized by a lesion resembling māṣa; lesion resembling mudga; reddish-coloured eruptions.

śiraḥ, mūrdhā, uttamāṅgam, mastakam, kapālaḥ, śaṅkhaḥ, Forehead, lalāṭam, alikam शिरः, मूर्धा, उत्तमाङ्गम्, मस्तकम् , कपालः , शङ्खः , ललाटम्, अलिकम्
Head
The uppermost and chief part of the body; head, the site where life force and the sense organs are situated.

ITA-1.7.10 uttaram उत्तरम्
Rejoinder
The response or reply to a challenge or objection.

ITA-9.2.85 uttarabastiḥ उत्तरबस्तिः
Administration of therapeutic fluid via vaginal or urethral route
A procedure in which medicated oil, ghee or a decoction is administered via the vaginal or urethral route.

ITA-9.2.104 uttarabasti उत्तरबस्ति
Intrauterine instillation of medicated liquids
The procedure of controlled, slow instillation of medicated liquids into the uterine cavity.

ITA-9.6.166 uttarabastikarma (vraṇacikitsā) उत्तरबस्तिकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Intraurethral douching Intraurethral administration of a decoction or oily emulsion for for wound management urethral and bladder wound management.

ITA-2.6.35 uttarādhara-vibhāgaḥ उत्तराधरविभागः
Superior-inferior division
An arbitrary division of the body into superior (cranial) and inferior (caudal) parts for descriptive purposes.

ITA-5.30.2 uttāna-vātaraktam उत्तान-वातरक्तम्
Superficial polyarthritis due to vitiated vata and blood
Multiple joint pain, itching; burning sensation; feeling of stretching; pricking pain; pulsating sensation; contraction; brownish black discoloration of skin; coppery discoloration on exterior of skin; reddish discoloration of skin.
